scenarios.name: adjacent-comparison-gap

concepts.title: Bubble Sort
concepts.description: Sort values using adjacent comparisons and swaps.

objectives: Identify which adjacent pair should be swapped.

bootstrap_responses.prompt: Which pair should Bubble Sort swap?
bootstrap_responses.rationale: Compare adjacent values, swapping only when out of order.

scenarios.expected_correction: Compare adjacent out-of-order values rather than arbitrary pairs.
